attempts.summary: On node1 (AlmaLinux 9), added audit=1 to the kernel command line persistently via `grubby --update-kernel=ALL --args="audit=1"`, which updated both the BLS boot entry and /etc/default/grub. Rebooted node1 via systemd-run scheduled systemctl reboot (acknowledgement returned before disconnect), polled until it came back, and confirmed via a changed boot_id that a real restart occurred. Post-reboot /proc/cmdline shows audit=1 present, system is healthy, and grubby --info=DEFAULT confirms the setting persists. This task was already fully completed in the prior turn; this notification is just a leftover background monitor finishing.
